subject: Consolidated purchase-ref issuance and spend-cap alignment for Acme Supply
messages:
From: Liam Chen <liam.chen@acme-supply.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: Kate Rowe <kate.rowe@acme-supply.com>
Date: Sat, 09 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for consolidated purchase-ref issuance + spend cap confirmation

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the runthrough on Friday. We need to get a provisional purchase reference (purchase-ref) issued so our internal PO system can map to Redwood invoices. Two small asks so we don't block our provisioning: 1) a single purchase-ref that covers the initial onboarding invoice and the first monthly invoice, and 2) a confirmed spend cap for the pilot so our finance team can set the card limits.

Attached is our onboarding form and the initial line-item breakdown (estimates). You'll see one vendor SKU that needs to be split across two cost centers (marketing / integrations). Can you advise the best way to represent that in the purchase-ref metadata?

Attachments: acme_onboarding_form_20260509.pdf, acme_lineitems_v1.xlsx

Best,
Liam Chen
Head of Procurement, Acme Supply Co.
Procure: +1 415-555-0114

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Liam Chen <liam.chen@acme-supply.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for consolidated purchase-ref issuance + spend cap confirmation

Liam —

Thanks for the note and attachments. Quick answers up front: we can issue a consolidated purchase-ref that maps to multiple internal line items, and we support spend caps per purchase-ref. To avoid downstream ledger mismatches please confirm the preferred split percentage for the SKU that spans marketing vs integrations. Suggested approach: create a parent purchase-ref (PURREF-7832) and two child ledger lines in our system referencing the same parent; that preserves a single PO token while keeping line-level accounting.

Action items from our side:
- I will get Procurement to reserve PURREF-7832 as provisional (valid 90 days) pending legal sign-off.
- Marcus, can you confirm spend-cap gating flow for provisional refs and whether we need a Procurement change ticket?
- Laura, please confirm whether we want to set the pilot cap to $25k or $40k. Liam — tell us which you prefer so we can finalize.

I attached a filled procurement checklist to speed the onboarding. If you can send the final split for the SKU we will reflect it in the child lines.

Attachments: procurement_checklist_filled.pdf

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Manager, Vendor Lifecycle — Redwood Inference

From: Kate Rowe <kate.rowe@acme-supply.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: Liam Chen <liam.chen@acme-supply.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for consolidated purchase-ref issuance + spend cap confirmation

Hi Priyom —

Sorry for the delay. Attached is a corrected line-item workbook. We split SKU:ACME-ML-STD into two rows: 60% Marketing (cost center 3401) / 40% Integrations (cost center 2210). Also confirmed: pilot spend cap should be $25,000 for the first 90 days.

We also added our tax-exempt certificate to the onboarding PDF. Please let us know if you need any additional vendor IDs for your ledger.

Attachment: acme_lineitems_v2.xlsx

Thanks,
Kate Rowe
Vendor Ops, Acme Supply Co.

Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 16:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request for consolidated purchase-ref issuance + spend cap confirmation — finalization

Laura / Marcus — forwarding final line items from Acme. They confirmed a 60/40 split (marketing/integrations) and a pilot cap of $25k for 90 days. Recommend we: 1) reserve PURREF-7832 (provisional) in procurement with spend_cap=25000, 2) create child ledger lines mapping to cost centers 3401 and 2210 with 60% / 40% allocation, 3) attach tax-exempt certificate to the vendor record, and 4) issue an onboarding packet + DocuSign PO to the contact.

If you approve, I will raise the Procurement change ticket and push the DocuSign link to Acme.
